category.name: Translation and language
category.description: Machine translation, grammar and style checking.

entries.name: Amazon Translate
entries.auth_hint: AWS SigV4 (IAM credentials) via AWS SDK/CLI
entries.free_tier: free tier: 2M characters/month for 12 months (new AWS accounts)
entries.desc_en: Translate text and documents in real time or batch across 75+ languages via the AWS SDK/API.
entries.notes: Requires an AWS account and IAM credentials; missing from the candidate list despite being a major agent-callable translation API.

entries.name: Azure AI Translator
entries.desc_en: Translate text, detect language, and transliterate across 100+ languages via REST API within Azure AI Services.
entries.notes: F0 free tier excludes custom model training/hosting, which are billed separately.

entries.name: DeepL API
entries.free_tier: API Free plan retired mid-2026 for new signups; now Developer/Growth paid plans with trial credits
entries.desc_en: Translate and rephrase text or documents between 30+ languages via REST API, SDKs, or an official MCP server.
entries.notes: DeepL retired the API Free plan around July 2026; no more permanent free tier for new signups.

entries.name: Google Cloud Translation
entries.auth_hint: OAuth2/IAM (GCP service account), or a simple API key for the Basic v2 edition
entries.free_tier: free tier: 500,000 characters/month (permanent, not a trial)
entries.desc_en: Translate text/documents and detect language across 100+ languages via REST/gRPC API within Google Cloud.
entries.notes: Advanced (v3) edition supports glossaries/custom models; requires a GCP project with billing enabled even for free usage.

entries.name: LanguageTool API
entries.auth_hint: username + api_key query params (Premium); anonymous on the free public endpoint
entries.free_tier: free, no key needed on public endpoint (rate-limited: 20 req/min, 75,000 chars/min)
entries.desc_en: Check grammar, style, and spelling in 30+ languages via a public HTTP API, with an optional Premium key for higher limits.
entries.notes: This is a proofreading/grammar API, not machine translation.

entries.name: ModernMT API
entries.free_tier: free trial (no credit card); no permanent free tier, paid plans from $8/M characters
entries.desc_en: Send adaptive neural machine translation requests with in-context learning via a REST API.
entries.notes: ModernMT is being folded into a new product called Lara; ModernMT API compatibility is stated to continue only until Dec 31, 2026 - plan for migration.
